limitations: Flat facet Shell4 element cannot capture curved-shell membrane-bending coupling: its ladder oscillates around a value ~50% above the reference
Cylindrical shell4 is specialized for cylindrical geometry only
General curved shells require either specialized elements or improved flat facet formulations
Accuracy is certified at the Richardson limit of a 4-level ladder; a finer reference value (more than four significant digits) is required to certify sub-0.1% claims
